action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Cinder Breath {@recharge}
entries: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of smoldering ash. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mephit's next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it leaves behind a cloud of smoke that fills a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on its space. The sphere is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured}. Wind disperses the cloud, which otherwise lasts for 1 minute.
